description: The grouped vertical bar chart illustrates the performance of three metrics—ROUGE-1, ROUGE-2, and ROUGE-L—across five different step intervals. The horizontal axis contains the categories, labeled "Step" via a small gray box below the axis, and displays the values 100, 250, 500, 1000, and 2000 in ascending numerical order. There is no visible vertical value axis line, tick marks, or axis label; instead, the values are represented by the heights of the bars and explicitly annotated above each bar, ranging from a minimum of 0.1 to a maximum of 41.2. The chart features grouped bars, with three bars clustered together for each step category. According to the legend in the top left corner, the blue bar with diagonal hatching represents ROUGE-1, the light green bar with a dotted pattern represents ROUGE-2, and the orange bar with cross-hatching represents ROUGE-L. Within each group, the bars are arranged from left to right in the order of ROUGE-1, ROUGE-2, and ROUGE-L. All bars are outlined in black and feature exact numerical annotations above them. The values for all three metrics consistently increase as the step categories progress from 100 to 2000. The shortest bar in the chart is ROUGE-2 at step 100, with a value of 0.1, while the tallest bar is ROUGE-1 at step 2000, reaching a value of 41.2. For the intermediate steps, the annotated values for ROUGE-1, ROUGE-2, and ROUGE-L are 11.6, 0.4, and 8.3 at step 250; 21.1, 4.1, and 15.9 at step 500; and 38.3, 16.5, and 30.7 at step 1000, respectively.
